Package com.sciometrics.android.slapshot.api.capture

Interface ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI

All Known Implementing Classes:
SlapshotCaptureEngine
public interface ISlapshotCaptureEngineUI
the UI portion Slapshot engine interface the is aware of Android's lifecycle. Calls to this interface tap into the life-cycle events of the hosting activity, and capture/calibration requests take over the view of the passed in fragment id

  • Method Details

    • init

      void init(androidx.fragment.app.FragmentActivity activity, InitializationCallback callback)
      initialization of the slapshot ui engine. Needs to be called before other calls to the engine other than ISlapshotCaptureEngine.configure(ICaptureEngineConfig). Initialization is asynchronous. You must wait for InitializationCallback.onSuccess() or InitializationCallback.onError() to be called. This needs to be called by EVERY parent onCreate() call as it takes reference to 'activity' until destroy() is called.
      Parameters:
      activity - the parent activity. A reference will be held onto this context until destroy() is called
      callback - the callback called on success or error of initialization

    • runCaptureSequence

      void runCaptureSequence(int fragmentResourceId, ICaptureRequestSequence captureRequestSequence, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      runs the requested capture sequence. The engine takes over control of the passed in until one of the callbacks in is called. This uses the FragmentManager of the to do so.
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the capture sequence. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      captureRequestSequence - the capture request sequence that will set what biometrics will be captured
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the capture sequence terminates successfully (ICaptureStatusCallback.onSuccess(ICaptureIdentity)) or on error (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String))
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an immediate error occurred before the capture sequence has begun

    • runCalibration

      void runCalibration(int fragmentResourceId, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      runs a request to calibrate the device. The device can already be calibrated. The calibration is saved or overwritten only after the calibration completes. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String). The engine takes over control of the passed in until one of the callbacks in is called. This uses the FragmentManager of the to do so. Model-based calibration is used if ICaptureEngineConfig.getUseModelBasedCalibrationByDefault() is true.
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the calibration routine. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the calibration terminates. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String).
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an immediate error occurred before the calibration has begun

    • runCalibration

      void runCalibration(int fragmentResourceId, boolean tryModelBasedCalibration, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      runs a request to calibrate the device. The device can already be calibrated. The calibration is saved or overwritten only after the calibration completes. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String). The engine takes over control of the passed in until one of the callbacks in is called. This uses the FragmentManager of the to do so. If is used, then model based calibration will be used if a model-based calibration loaded in ISlapshotCaptureEngine.addModelBasedCalibration(byte[]) matches the running device. Otherwise, default calibration will be used.
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the calibration routine. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      tryModelBasedCalibration - if true, model-based calibration is used instead of default calibration
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the calibration terminates. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of calibration, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String).
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • runCalibrationValidation

      void runCalibrationValidation(int fragmentResourceId, int numberOfValidationCaptures, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      runs a validation routine on the existing calibration for the device. Routine will guide the user through captures of a target and validate the calibration based on the captures. At the end of the routine, the user will be presented with the validation results. An error or invalidated calibration will not change the existing state of any calibration on the device, it only presents the diagnostic results to the user. If no calibration is found to validate, an error is raised through the .
      Parameters:
      fragmentResourceId - the resource id of the fragment that the engine will use to display the views required to run the calibration routine. Control of the fragment will be returned to the caller when a call to is made
      numberOfValidationCaptures - the number of validation captures that the user will be guided through. If less than or equal to 0, will effectively be 1.
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance which will be called when the validation terminates. A call to ICaptureStatusCallback.onCalibrationSuccess() will occur on success of validation, otherwise (ICaptureStatusCallback.onError(ICaptureIdentity, CaptureError, String).
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - error

    • restore

      boolean restore(android.os.Bundle savedInstanceState, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      restores the state of the UI engine. Should be called after a successful callback to init(FragmentActivity, InitializationCallback) when the activity is being restored (savedInstanceState != null). The updated callback instance needs to be resent here as the instance might have changed since the initial call to runCaptureSequence(int, ICaptureRequestSequence, ICaptureStatusCallback) or runCalibration(int, ICaptureStatusCallback), etc
      Parameters:
      savedInstanceState - the saved instance state to restore the state of the engine
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance for any active calls to the UI's capture/calibration requests.
      Returns:
      true if a slapshot view has been restored. False if no Slapshot view has been restored
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error occurred

    • restore

      boolean restore(android.os.Bundle savedInstanceState, int viewResourceOverride, ICaptureStatusCallback captureStatusCallback) throws com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException
      restores the state of the UI engine. Should be called after a successful callback to init(FragmentActivity, InitializationCallback) when the activity is being restored (savedInstanceState != null). The updated callback instance needs to be resent here as the instance might have changed since the initial call to runCaptureSequence(int, ICaptureRequestSequence, ICaptureStatusCallback) or runCalibration(int, ICaptureStatusCallback), etc
      Parameters:
      savedInstanceState - the saved instance state to restore the state of the engine
      viewResourceOverride - an id of a view that Slapshot's UI components will restore to. This can be used when the view id used when the state was saved is no longer valid. This can be true when integrating with technologies like React Native.
      captureStatusCallback - the callback instance for any active calls to the UI's capture/calibration requests.
      Returns:
      true if a slapshot view has been restored. False if no Slapshot view has been restored
      Throws:
      com.sciometrics.core.util.SlapshotException - an error occurred

    • exportCalibration

      void exportCalibration()
      prompts user for a location to save a copy of the current calibration for the device. This is meant to be used to generate a calibration file to represent the model of the device that can subsequently be used in ISlapshotCaptureEngine.addModelBasedCalibration(byte[]) if that calibration file is embedded into an app supporting model-based calibration. This cannot be called before init(FragmentActivity, InitializationCallback)
